item.name: Boots of Bearing

effects.title: Endurance
effects.text:
Gives +50 attack speed and +15% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds. For the first 1.5 seconds allies are immune to slows.

 Radius: 1200

effects.title: Swiftness Aura
effects.text:
Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.  

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

item.lore: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.
